stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_complete: An rubuta kammala aikin da saukar komawa gida. Ka sake gwada wannan aikin da sauyi guda da ka zaɓa a sarrafawa ko hanya, sannan ka kwatanta abubuwan lura da aka adana.
stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_depleted: Batirin jirgin marar matuƙi ya ƙare. Fara sabon aiki, yi amfani da gajerun hanyoyi kuma ka tsara komawa kafin batirin ya yi ƙasa.
stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_unknown: Wannan aikin yana da shaidun da ba su cika ba ko masu saɓani. Duba abin da aka rubuta, sannan ka fara sabon gwaji.
stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_capture: Ba a ɗauki wasu maƙasudai ba tukuna. A sabon aiki, kusanci maƙasudi ɗaya a lokaci guda kuma ka riƙe tsawo da gudun dangane da ƙasa cikin iyakokin da aka nuna har sai an rubuta ɗaukar.
stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_recovery: Ba a ceci wanda ya tsira ba. A sabon aikin ceto, gwada tsayawa a sararin sama cikin natsuwa a iyakokin tsawo, karkata daga wuri da gudun tsaye da aka nuna kafin ka koma sansani.
stem.flightsim.coaching_mission_return: An rubuta manufofin ɗauko mutum ko ɗaukar maƙasudi; saukar komawa gida ta rage. Fara sabon aiki, sannan ka keɓe lokaci da ƙarfin batiri domin komawa sansani.
stem.flightsim.mission_reflection_prompt: Wace shawara game da maƙasudi, tsayawa a sararin sama ko komawa za ka canza? Yi amfani da abubuwan lura na aikin don bayyana zaɓinka da tsara sauyi guda don sabon gwaji. Za a adana bayaninka tare da wannan jirgi.
stem.flightsim.journal_different_airport: An yi waɗannan kusantowar sauka a filayen jirgi daban-daban. Duba abubuwan luransu dabam; ba a lissafa sauye-sauyen ma’auni ba.
stem.flightsim.challenge_brake_release: Saki X kuma ka kashe birkin ƙafafu a Deck kafin ka ƙara ƙarfi.
